adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts` the `isTeamAdminOrOwner` flag is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which only returns true if the caller is both an admin and an owner of the team. The subsequent auth gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN;` means a team admin who is not also an owner will be denied access, breaking the intended “team admin OR owner” authorization path.
